Jaishankar addresses UN on Global South, energy, AI, and UNSC

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar addressed the United Nations, raising concerns about oil price volatility and advocating for developing nations' participation in global decision-making. He presented a seven-point agenda for the Global South, addressing challenges from supply chains and energy to food security and Artificial Intelligence (AI). Jaishankar emphasized the need to prevent new inequalities in the AI era and called for greater inclusion of developing countries in global governance. Discussions also touched upon India's potential permanent seat at the UN Security Council (UNSC), with reports indicating increased support and European backing for reform. Jaishankar also held bilateral meetings with counterparts from the UAE, France, and Nepal, focusing on collaboration in AI, space, energy, and development partnerships.
